help: Projects and real tasks are discovered through the Gradle Tooling API. Sync configures the selected build. Gradle may download its distribution and project dependencies. Hidden panels stop polling.
directoryHelp: Absolute path to a folder with settings.gradle, build.gradle, their .kts variants, or a Gradle wrapper.
syncHint: Sync to discover projects and tasks.
noBuild: No Gradle build in this workspace. Link a build directory to get started.
